notes.title: Stories of Mara, a visual novel slice-of-life will be out on August 26th!
notes.content:
Hi there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791781/2c6763d5a05102a8f68c824187f9addf6709f68c.jpg[/img]

We're thrill to announce that [b]Stories of Mara[/b], an episodic visual novel that tells the story of the neighbors of Mara,[b] will be out on August 26th[/b]! Chapter One will be [b]free on Steam[/b] and Itch.io. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1647780/Stories_of_Mara/

Set in the same universe as Deiland Pocket Planet and Summer in Mara, [b]Stories of Mara describe the little tidbits of life happening in these islands where your choices will define the course of the story[/b] and affect the relationships with the community.

[previewyoutube=8gjeRRMm1lM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Chapter One starts following Akaji[/b], a procrastinating blacksmith who has to ask for the help of all her neighbors to find Koa, who has disappeared while dealing with her own issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791781/9b23aefd1383eec7c4d115a8bd36b553f5ecb0f2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791781/734b1125f9fdc948aa418057e2be3de0eb51f1ed.png[/img]


Key Features

  [list]
[*]  [b] A bit-sized slice of life visual novel[/b] following a diverse cast from the calm and relaxing supernatural world of Summer in Mara. A soap opera featuring from trickster pirates to adventurer cat-children.    

[*]     Depending on how you bond with the cast will affect the relationships with the community and the ending. [b]Your choices matter in the course of the story[/b] throughout different chapters.
 
[*]      [b]Express yourself through making boat modelism [/b]to share with the rest of the community. This will impact how they see you and how you see them.

[*][b]Visuals inspired by the Studio Ghibli [/b]films with a modern setting in a fantasy universe.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791781/98224c81623396cece46459d49922eff5a4a28c4.gif[/img]

See you in Mara!

notes.title: 20% daily deal & Summer in Mara Collector’s Edition!
notes.content:
Dear travelers of Mara,

We’re happy to announce that the world of Summer in Mara reaches out beyond the game. With the The Art of Summer in Mara and Summer in Mara Original Soundtrack, you’ll be able to explore this vast ocean in a unique way.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15987/Summer_in_Mara_Collectors_Edition/

Also, if you don’t have the game yet, now it’s your chance to get the collector's edition with the Artbook and the OST!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1380090/The_Art_of_Summer_in_Mara/

The Art from Summer in Mara includes:
[list]
[*] Over 180 pages of concept art, background, key art, characters, and props.
[*] Information never seen from your favorite (and most hated) characters from the game.
[*] Discover the whole process: from the idea to the final step.
[*] Exclusive look at the creative work behind the cinematics.
[*] Lots of lore, because reading is fun!
[*] Sheet music of the opening song for ukulele.
[/list]


And don’t miss the OST:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1400590/Summer_in_Mara__OST/

The beach under your feet, the breeze on your face, the waves on your ear. Feel Summer in Mara everywhere thanks to the Summer in Mara Original Soundtrack, created by Paco Mitos & Adrián Berenguer. From the relaxing and calm beaches of Mara to the exciting pirate adventures and the moving feelings of a lost and found orphan child.
